Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: After the Orchestrator instructed a DHL lookup, WebSurfer clicked a FedEx link instead (“I clicked ‘Calculate Shipping Rates - FedEx’”), failing to follow directions. This misnavigation diverted effort back to FedEx, stalled progress on DHL/USPS rates, and contributed to not obtaining the necessary comparisons to produce the required JSON answer.
